messages:
Avery: FYI postmortem highlights 126: intermittent cloud control-plane auth 5xx cascaded into model-registry writeback queue overload. We saw token refresh storms at scale. Need owners + short/med/long term actions.
Kofi: Timeline: 01:4201:55 UTC spike. Writes backed up, retries amplified. I can own immediate client-side changes (full jitter, per-client concurrency cap). Target: PR Wed.
Rina: I'll take registry-side mitigation: make writeback queue durable+rate-limited and add immediate read-only fallback for requests older than 30s. ETA: next Tue.
Marcus: I'll wire an alert: "auth_exchange_5xx > 2% & registry_write_err > 1% for 5m" with runbook link and pager routing to oncall. Also add vendor incident link auto-attach. ETA: tomorrow AM.
Avery: Good. Also propose a two-week "vendor-dep pulse" to catch recurrence patterns; who takes the weekly check?
Kofi: I'll cover the first week, handoff to Rina week two. I'll prepare a short checklist (deploys, retry amplification, vendor incident overlap).
ops-bot: Created ticket: [AUTH-621] "Client jitter + concurrency cap" assigned to Kofi (due 2026-04-01). https://jira.redwood/AUTH-621
ops-bot: Created ticket: [REG-511] "Durable rate-limited writeback + readonly fallback" assigned to Rina (due 2026-04-05). https://jira.redwood/REG-511
ops-bot: Created ticket: [OPS-238] "Auth+registry compound alert + runbook" assigned to Marcus (due 2026-03-29). https://jira.redwood/OPS-238
Kofi: I'll add a CI smoke that simulates a token-thundering scenario and a small metric to measure retry amplification. Example I'd add:
```
# simulate token-thundering
python tests/simulate_token_thundering.py --workers 250 --expiry-jitter 0
```
Rina: For REG-511 runbook snippet: if writeback_queue_depth > 500 and write_errors >= 3 in 60s -> enable read-only snapshot mode, pause non-critical syncs for 15m, notify #incidents, and escalate to Avery.
Marcus: I'll also prototype a temporary routing policy to a colocated quantized replica if auth errors persist > 5m; need product signoff for perf/cost.
Avery: Action recap for postmortem doc (I'll update):
- Kofi: AUTH-621 PR by Wed
- Rina: REG-511 impl + runbook by Tue
- Marcus: OPS-238 alert + canary + runbook link by tomorrow AM
- Avery: vendor-dep pulse calendar + postmortem owners update
ops-bot: Note: AUTH-621 status -> in-progress (updated by Kofi)
Kofi: I'll post PR + smoke logs here when ready.
Rina: Will add perf notes for read-only variance to REG-511.
Avery: Thanks team. Keep updates here; if we see recurrence escalate to #incidents and ping me.
Marcus: :white_check_mark:
